label: In a conservation area
description: Site is in or partly in a conservation area (planning.data.gov.uk dataset conservation-area).

label: Listed building
description: Site is, or contains, a listed building or is within its curtilage (dataset listed-building).

label: Affects a listed building's setting
description: The proposal could affect the setting of a listed building.

label: Locally listed building
description: Site is or contains a locally listed (non-designated) heritage asset (dataset locally-listed-building).

label: World Heritage Site
description: Site is in a World Heritage Site (MHCLG use this value in design-and-access-statement; dataset world-heritage-site).

label: Archaeological priority area
description: Site is in an area of archaeological potential or priority (dataset archaeological-priority-area).

label: Flood zone 2 or 3
description: Site is in Environment Agency flood zone 2 or 3 (dataset flood-risk-zone).

label: Tree preservation order
description: Site has trees protected by a tree preservation order (dataset tree-preservation-zone).

label: National Landscape (AONB)
description: Site is in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty / National Landscape (dataset area-of-outstanding-natural-beauty).

label: SSSI on or near site
description: Site is in or next to a Site of Special Scientific Interest (dataset site-of-special-scientific-interest).

label: Near a Special Protection Area
description: Site is in the zone of influence of a Special Protection Area (dataset special-protection-area).

label: In the Green Belt
description: Site is in the Green Belt (dataset green-belt).

label: Coal mining high risk area
description: Site is in a Coal Authority development high risk area.

label: Known or suspected contamination
description: Site is known or suspected to be contaminated.

label: Nutrient neutrality catchment
description: Site is in a catchment where Natural England advise nutrient neutrality.

label: Water neutrality zone
description: Site is in a zone where water neutrality is required (e.g. Sussex North).

label: Air quality management area
description: Site is in an air quality management area.

label: New vehicle access
description: The proposal creates or alters a vehicle access onto a road.

label: Trees on or near the site
description: There are trees on the site or close enough to be affected (including street trees).

label: New or enlarged basement
description: The proposal includes a new or enlarged basement.

label: Includes demolition
description: The proposal involves demolishing a building or part of one.

label: External lighting
description: The proposal includes external or flood lighting.

label: Illuminated advert
description: The advertisement is illuminated.

label: Loss of an existing use
description: The proposal would lose an existing employment, community, retail or similar use.

label: Food, drink or extraction plant
description: The proposal is for a food or drink use, or includes ventilation or extraction plant.

label: Structural alterations
description: The proposal involves structural alterations (for example to a listed building).

label: Building height (m)
description: Height of the tallest proposed building in metres.

label: Storeys
description: Number of storeys in the tallest proposed building.
